name: Shiogane Kyouko
source: Inaho Shin's co-worker at the café "YuKuRu." Both her and Shin had started the café about a year earlier, having left their previous workplace together. To Shin, she's an irreplaceable partner, and to youths, a confident older sister whom you could consult with.
